program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    base = grid[0][0]
    sep = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x != base).most_common(1)[0][0]
    k = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row.count(sep) > len(row) // 2)
    bad_rows = [r for r in range(k, len(grid), k + 1)
                for c in range(k, len(grid[0]), k + 1) if grid[r][c] == base]
    bad_cols = [c for c in range(k, len(grid[0]), k + 1)
                for r in range(k, len(grid), k + 1) if grid[r][c] == base]
    top = min(bad_rows) // (k + 1) + 1
    bottom = max(bad_rows) // (k + 1) + 1
    left = min(bad_cols) // (k + 1) + 1
    right = max(bad_cols) // (k + 1) + 1
    tiles = [[[row[col * (k + 1):col * (k + 1) + k]
               for row in grid[rr * (k + 1):rr * (k + 1) + k]]
              for col in range(left, right)] for rr in range(top, bottom)]
    width = (right - left) * (k + 1) + 1
    out = [[base] + [sep] * (width - 2) + [base]]
    for tile_row in tiles:
        for r in range(k):
            out.append([sep] + [x for tile in tile_row for x in tile[r] + [sep]])
        out.append([sep] * width)
    out[-1] = [base] + [sep] * (width - 2) + [base]
    return out
'''
